notes.general_comments:
Most candidates produced work that was clear and well presented.
It is pleasing to note that most candidates now use g = 10 ms (the acceleration due to gravity), as instructed
in the rubric, and not g = 9.8 or 9.81.
A good clear diagram can often help with thinking through a question and deciding how to solve the problem.
